experiments.claim: Journaled recovery prevents duplicate non-repeatable effects while recovering safe repeatable effects at every injected fault boundary.
experiments.control: naive restart after the same injected crash
experiments.treatment: hash-chained journal plus executeStepAttempt and recoverStepAttempt
invalid_substitutions: a unit assertion presented as a process-kill or power-loss result

experiments.claim: Citadel blocks every declared malicious action while allowing its benign matched cases and never converts missing or malformed evidence into a pass.
experiments.control: same case corpus with hook decisions disabled
experiments.treatment: protect-files, external-action-gate, and governance decisions enabled
invalid_substitutions: classifying an unexecuted dangerous command as a real exploit

experiments.claim: Deterministic gates plus an acting arbiter reduce false acceptance of green-but-wrong changes relative to prose-only handoff validation.
experiments.control: phase validator judges a blinded HANDOFF only
experiments.treatment: deterministic gates rerun before a different-family acting arbiter judges the real diff

experiments.claim: Isolated parallel Fleet execution reduces elapsed time or intervention burden on decomposable work without reducing accepted verified completion.
experiments.control: matched tasks executed serially with the same model and budget
experiments.treatment: matched tasks executed by isolated Fleet worktrees with discovery relay
gates: interventions improve >= 0.25 or wall time improves materially
external_dependencies: frozen external verifier or independent owner judgment

experiments.claim: On externally selected matched tasks, Citadel is non-inferior on accepted completion and improves recovery or corrective-intervention burden within bounded time overhead.
experiments.control: bare agent with the same runtime, model, OS, and counterbalanced assignment
experiments.treatment: Citadel-enabled agent on its matched assignment

experiments.claim: A single leased deploy steward avoids merge races and lands matched PR batches with no more interventions than independent concurrent merge loops.
experiments.control: independent merge loops operating on a shared matched PR fixture
experiments.treatment: serialized leased steward operating on the same fixture
invalid_substitutions: fake provider results presented as GitHub behavior
admin bypass presented as strict branch protection

experiments.claim: A lean runtime distribution can reduce acquisition bytes while preserving installed runtime behavior and hash-bound offline evidence replay.
experiments.control: npm package and GitHub release composition at the frozen source commit
experiments.treatment: runtime profile with separately accounted evidence and site-media artifacts
gates: runtime and total published bytes reported
invalid_substitutions: proof data deleted before replay validation

publication_rule: Only observed gates may support public claims; missing external evidence remains unknown or blocked.
